verdict.rationale: Slack markets Slackbot as 'your personal AI agent' that can summarize channels, prepare meeting briefs, take huddle notes, and answer questions (e.g. via Claude), which matches delegating tasks to a built-in assistant. However, all evidence is first-party marketing copy with no independent/hands-on validation of task delegation reliability or scope. Missing for 10: independent verification of Slackbot's actual task-execution capabilities, technical documentation of what tasks it can autonomously perform, and evidence of real-world usage/limitations.
